cincinnati-metro-and-access-paratransit: Metro says Access drivers help riders on and off the vehicle lift or steps, secure wheelchairs or scooters and fasten seatbelts. This boarding assistance does not include lifting a rider into or out of their mobility device.
When your vehicle arrives, the driver will assist you on/off the vehicle lift or steps, secure your wheelchair or scooter, fasten your seatbelt and collect the fare.
Lift you in and out of wheelchairs or scooters. You must provide your own Personal Care Attendant (PCA) or escort for assistance. A PCA can ride free of charge.

For an Access reservation, have your name or ID, travel date, pickup and destination addresses, required arrival time and return pickup time ready. Tell the receptionist about any companion or personal care attendant and special driver instructions.

When making a reservation please have the following information. Your name or ID number. The date you would like to travel. The address of both pick up location and destination. The time you need to arrive at your destination. The time you need to be picked up for your return trip. Whether you will be traveling with a companion and / or personal care attendant. Special instructions for the driver.
